title: Adaptive CoT Jailbreaks vs a Cheap CoT-Length Anomaly Detector

original_idea.body: Tool-result parsing defense utility cost (extends arXiv:2601.04795): reimplement the filter, run 60 benign agent tasks across JSON/HTML/text, report robustness/utility tradeoff by format.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Characterizing a defense's utility cost is useful but the chain to catastrophic risk reduction is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reimplement a filter + 60 benign tasks across formats; bounded and guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused robustness/utility tradeoff curve; building diverse benign tasks adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Deployer-relevant defense characterization, no proprietary data; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Preprocessing filter + small task set; minimal compute.

novelty.reasoning: Defense exists; utility-cost-by-format characterization is a partly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Defense exists; benign-utility-cost angle may be open.
